habitat.status: Same construction coefficients as the three-deck reference. Flat faces need internal ties; a quarter of Earth gravity at about 5 rpm is unvalidated for 20 years.

surface_inflatables.status: Closed pressure vessels, so no ground anchoring against pressure. No orbital debris layer: surface use only. Seam life, deployment at 1.2 g and local weather are unqualified.

engine.status: 0.5c effective exhaust needs about 86% of the charged-pion momentum collimated and is at the ceiling of the beamed-core concept. Thermal closure at 1.2 g relies on the 1e-7 absorbed-fraction assumption, which no physical nozzle geometry here supports.

shadow_shield.status: Sized for dose only. The disc intercepts terawatts and cannot be cooled at 1.2 g; neutrons, muons, scatter round the edge and the true source size are not modelled.

storage.status: Only neutral condensed antihydrogen reaches the required density. Charged levitation, charge retention on the ice, 1.5 K walls and failure containment are undemonstrated; the 38 t containment figure is an allocation.

checks.basis: Euler cantilever, 250 m; the first 0.7 m-radius, 1.5 kg/m mast would buckle above 0.056 g.

checks.load: 1.43 MN in the burns; 5.02 MN in descent braking
checks.basis: Sized by buckling for descent thrust; the interstellar burn uses a fraction of it.
29.9 t per disc on four 240 mm carbon tubes; hub bearing not credited.
16 kg/m2 smeared over the envelope; limit set where inertial load reaches 10% of cabin pressure.

checks.load: 7.3 kN m root moment per rib
checks.basis: Four ribs with 6 cm2 carbon caps 0.5 m apart.
Assumed 10 MV/m charge-retention limit on the ice; an assumption, not a measurement. No safety factor applied.

checks.load: 3.2 kPa head on a 150 kPa shell
checks.basis: Limit where head reaches 20% of design pressure.

structure.status: Static screening of axial load paths only. Dynamics, thrust offset, slosh, joints and thermal distortion are not modelled.

unscreened.note: Solid front shield at the ship: every stopped proton is a thick-target gamma source. A 50 kg/m2 plate attenuates 4.4 MeV photons by only about 15%.

interstellar_flow.status: Thick-target yield is an order-of-magnitude estimate (factor of about two); neutrons, helium and heavier ions add to it. Film survival, hole statistics and charge-state fractions are assumptions.

dedicated_shelter_option.expected_reduction: roughly a quarter to a third; still far above the limit

cosmic_rays.status: Outside the heliosphere the low-energy flux is higher than this measurement. No passive mass this ship can carry meets a 600 mSv career limit over 20 years; this is an open mission-level item.

open_items: Engine heat: the nozzle coil alone intercepts about 12 TW of gamma rays against 0.09 GW assumed absorbed, a gap of about 1e+05.
Shadow shield heat: 2.6 TW intercepted against 7 MW radiated at 3,000 K.
Cosmic rays: about 13 Sv over 20 years against a 0.6 Sv career limit.
Antimatter storage: no demonstrated way to make, charge, levitate or safely fail hundreds of tonnes of antihydrogen ice.
